one_line: Early Maitraka ruler of Vallabhi whose land grants mark the dynasty’s shift from Gupta governors to independent kings.

appearance.age_look: Early 40s, medium height, solid but not bulky build, calm authoritative posture.
appearance.face: Oval face with sharp, thoughtful eyes, wheatish Saurashtra complexion, neatly trimmed beard and moustache, straight nose, faint lines at the brow; default expression composed and observant, hint of quiet determination.
appearance.hair: Dark brown-black hair, medium length, combed back and gathered into a small low knot at the back of the head; front hair smooth with a slight wave; adorned with a simple gold circlet across the forehead, the band thin and undecorated except for a small central round stud.
appearance.costume: He wears a knee-length white cotton tunic (angarkha-style) crossing left over right, with narrow gold piping at the edges and fitted half-sleeves; over this, a rich deep-red woolen shawl-cloak draped from the left shoulder across the chest and around the back, falling to mid-thigh with a subtle woven border in gold and dark brown; his lower garment is a finely pleated off-white cotton dhoti, wrapped securely to the ankles with clean vertical folds; around his waist is a broad dark-brown leather belt with a rectangular plain bronze buckle, from which hangs a small pouch; he wears simple gold karnika-style ear ornaments (small round studs with a slight dome), a single slender gold torque necklace close to the neck, and a thin gold bangle on each wrist; on his feet, brown leather sandals with toe loop and side straps; overall textiles look practical but high-status, with light embroidery only at borders and no excessive ornament.
appearance.signature: A rolled copper-plate grant tied with a dark cord and sealed with a circular royal seal bearing a stylized bull emblem, held in his left hand while his right hand lightly rests on the hilt of a sheathed straight-edged iron sword with a simple cross-guard and plain dark-brown leather scabbard hanging from his belt.

ref_desc: Dronasimha Maitraka is a wheatish-complexioned, bearded man in a white tunic, off-white dhoti, deep-red shoulder-draped shawl, gold circlet and simple jewellery, carrying a rolled copper-plate grant and a plain sheathed sword in a dark-brown belt, with a deep-red, white, off-white, dark-brown and gold palette.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Dronasimha Maitraka: a dignified early-40s man with wheatish Saurashtra complexion, oval thoughtful face, neat beard and moustache, dark brown-black hair combed back into a small low knot, and a thin gold circlet on his forehead. Show his white cotton angarkha-style tunic crossing left over right with narrow gold piping, a deep-red woolen shawl-cloak draped from his left shoulder across his chest and around his back to mid-thigh, and an off-white cotton dhoti pleated to the ankles. Add a broad dark-brown leather belt with bronze buckle, small pouch, and a plain straight-edged iron sword in a dark-brown leather scabbard hanging at his side. Include small gold ear studs, a slender gold torque necklace, thin gold bangles on each wrist, and brown leather sandals. In his left hand he firmly holds a rolled copper-plate grant tied with a dark cord and marked by a circular seal with a stylized bull; his right hand rests lightly on the sword hilt. Emphasize the deep-red, white, off-white, dark-brown and gold colour palette and a composed, authoritative stance suitable for a ruler overseeing legal land grants.
